name: Microsoft Fairwater Wisconsin

timeline.event: Building 1 cooling and backup generators all look complete from above but there is still construction visible around the building. Building 2 is well underway with a foundation and a complete substation. Large carpark and concrete area nort
Building 1 looks complete, but based on Microsoft announcements, it's not fully operational yet. Steel framing is underway for Building 2.
Building 1 is operational. [X post](https://x.com/satyanadella/status/2044767391293509761?s=61) from Microsoft saying this date for Fairwater becoming operational.

The main shell of Building 2 looks almost completed. In Area 2 (northwest of Buildings 1-2), the grading for the original design has been replaced with grading for the new [9-building design](https://www.mtpleasantwi.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFi

Building 2 is operational. This is estimated based on (1) the delay between Building 1 and Building 2 starting land clearing, (2) in March 2025, a Microsoft spokesperson [said](https://www.wpr.org/news/microsoft-pauses-construction-on-parts

Buildings 3-11 are estimated to be operational. The grading for this revised 9-building plan was underway in May 2026, and we assume an average 2-year [build time](https://epoch.ai/data-insights/data-centers-buildout-speeds) from that point

sources.quote: Microsoft Fairwater Wisconsin: current power 369 MW; owner Microsoft.

explain: Microsoft Fairwater Wisconsin is an operating AI data center in Mount Pleasant, WI, owned by microsoft and used by openai. Epoch AI estimates it draws 369 MW today and 2,715 MW when finished.
